channel.title: WPEG Mortgage Calculator Changelog
channel.description: New features, fixes, and improvements to the Winnipeg Mortgage Calculator, newest first.

item.title: v1.3.0: Primary source citations, Manitoba Land Transfer Tax, and payment schedules
item.description:
A major accuracy and transparency release adding official primary source citations, Manitoba Land Transfer Tax closing calculations, Canadian payment schedules, interactive down payment controls, and full keyboard accessibility. (November 11, 2026)

  • Official Primary Source Citations: Every statutory calculation, interest formula, tax bracket, and lending policy is now verified and cited directly to primary Canadian and Manitoba government legislation, complete with official reference links.
  • Manitoba Land Transfer Tax & Cash to Close: Plan ahead with complete visibility into completion day costs. The calculator now automatically computes Manitoba's graduated Land Transfer Tax sliding scale and Land Titles registration fees.
  • Flexible Canadian Payment Schedules: Switch seamlessly between Monthly, Semi-Monthly, Bi-Weekly, Accelerated Bi-Weekly, Weekly, and Accelerated Weekly schedules to see how paying more frequently can pay down your loan years earlier.
  • Synchronized Down Payment Slider & Tiers: Fine-tune your down payment with a fluid interactive range slider or jump instantly to standard Canadian lending tiers (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%) with a single tap.
  • Household Income & Affordability Check: Enter your actual annual household income to evaluate your Gross Debt Service (GDS) ratio against real Canadian lending thresholds (32%–39%).
  • WAI-ARIA Keyboard Accessibility & Contrast: The entire application is now fully keyboard navigable, including full arrow-key and escape-key support for the 20+ color theme menu, screen reader live announcements, and calibrated contrast.

item.title: v1.2.0: Unified design, Canadian semi-annual compounding, and smart cost estimates
item.description:
A major quality-of-life update bringing a unified WPEG look and feel, smarter calculations, and a richer set of tools to help you navigate the Winnipeg housing market with confidence. (November 11, 2026)

  • Accurate Canadian Mortgage Calculations: Mortgage payments are now calculated using the official Canadian semi-annual compounding method — the same standard used by banks across the country. Numbers you can trust.
  • Over 20 Color Themes: Make the calculator your own. Choose from more than 20 handcrafted color palettes — from classic navy to warm autumn tones — all designed to meet accessibility contrast standards.
  • Dark Mode & Light Mode: Seamlessly toggle between dark and light mode at any time. Your preference is remembered across visits so the tool always looks the way you like it.
  • Unified WPEG Design: The calculator now shares the same polished header, footer, and brand identity as other WPEG tools — a consistent, professional experience across the entire WPEG family.
  • Winnipeg-Specific Cost Estimates: Get real-world context with estimated Winnipeg property tax rates, home heating costs, and home insurance — giving you a fuller picture of your true monthly housing costs.
  • CMHC Insurance Guidance: Automatically understand when mortgage insurance is required and how much it costs, based on your down payment and purchase price — with Canadian rules applied correctly.
  • Manitoba Land Transfer Tax & Closing Costs: Get a full breakdown of estimated cash needed on closing day, including Manitoba graduated Land Transfer Tax (LTT) and Land Titles registration fees.
  • Flexible Payment Schedules: Compare monthly, semi-monthly, bi-weekly, and accelerated bi-weekly schedules to see how paying more frequently can pay down your loan faster.
  • Mortgage Affordability Rating: See a plain-language affordability rating based on your gross monthly income. Understand at a glance whether a mortgage is comfortable, stretched, or beyond recommended limits.
  • Improved Reliability: Under the hood, we hardened every calculation against edge cases — zero values, unusual inputs, and extreme numbers all behave correctly. The tool is more stable and dependable than ever.

item.title: v1.1.0: Initial public release
item.description:
Initial public release of the Winnipeg Mortgage Calculator — a free tool for Winnipeg home buyers. (October 2026)

  • Mortgage Payment Estimator: Enter your purchase price, down payment, amortization period, and interest rate to get an instant monthly payment estimate.
  • Winnipeg Fun Facts: Discover local housing insights and neighbourhood context alongside your mortgage results.
